# Outtalent Everest helps engineers bring their career to global heights


## Applications for this batch are due June 6th


[Tilek Mamutov](https://medium.com/@tilek?source=post_page---byline--c67a1981d0a1---------------------------------------)


2 min read


·


Apr 29, 2021


--


Press enter or click to view image in full size


Outtalent helps outstanding developers around the world realize their potential on a global scale, independently of what’s said on their passport. We offer a 3-month online program that covers distributed system design, algorithms, data structures, personal branding, and salary negotiation. It is taught by senior engineers and engineering managers from Google, Facebook, Uber, and Stripe. And, participants pay only if they get a job in a top 10 company of their choice.


We believe Outtalent can help engineers achieve better results, just like coaches can help elite athletes. In a job search, it means more offers, at higher seniority levels, with higher salaries, from better companies, and in better cities.


Our results so far:


- Our most popular employers are Google (#1) and Facebook (#2)
- Our most popular city is London
- 100% of our last batch got an offer at either Amazon, Facebook, Google, or Microsoft
- On average, people got more than 3 offers from big tech companies
- Overall, we’ve helped fellows get offers from Amazon, Bloomberg, Cisco, DeepMind, Facebook, Flexport, Google, Microsoft, Reddit, Spotify, Stripe, TikTok, Uber, and Yelp in Europe, Canada, and the US.


If you know any software engineers from Russia, Ukraine, Belarus, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Georgia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Moldova, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, or Uzbekistan, please share this announcement with them.


Last day to apply: Sunday, June 6th
You can check your eligibility here:[https://outtalent.com/check](https://outtalent.com/check)
